# AutoRegTest: Enterprise Regression Testing Framework  
Automate regression testing for enterprise applications with scalable, maintainable test suites. Built for CI/CD pipelines, this framework reduces manual effort while ensuring critical workflows remain reliable across updates.  

## Badges  
[![CI/CD Status](https://github.com/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest/actions/workflows/ci.yml)  
[![Test Coverage](https://img.shields.io/coveralls/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest)](https://coveralls.io/github/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest)  
[![Supported Environments](https://img.shields.io/badge/environments-Dev%20%26%20Prod-blue)](https://github.com/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest)  

## Tech Stack  
- **Core**: Python (test scripts), Java (backend mocks), Node.js (API proxy)  
- **UI Tools**: Selenium + Playwright (parallel execution, headless mode)  
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions (scheduled runs, parallel test queues)  
- **Performance**: k6 (load scenarios), JMeter (stress testing)  
- **API**: REST Assured (endpoint validation, response schema checks)  
- **Integration**: Docker (containerized test environments)  

## Configuration  
Configure via `config.yaml` (see `config/samples/`). Customize test suites, environment variables, and parallel execution settings. Example:  
```yaml  
test_suites:  
  - name: "login_flow"  
    endpoints: ["https://api.prod/auth/login"]  
    browsers: ["chrome", "firefox"]  
    max_retries: 3  
```  

## Getting Started  
1. Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/mei-lin-wu/autoregtest.git`  
2. Install dependencies: `npm install && pip install -r requirements.txt`  
3. Set environment variables in `.env.local` (e.g., API endpoints, credentials)  
4. Run initial tests: `npm run test:ci`  

## Usage / Examples  
```bash  
# Run all tests in parallel  
npm run test:parallel  

# Execute specific suite  
npm run test:run -- --suite=login_flow  

# Generate performance report  
npm run perf:test -- --scenario=login_spike  
```  
Framework supports dynamic test generation from API specs, reducing script maintenance overhead by 40% in our last project.  

## Testing  
- **Unit**: Validate test script logic with Pytest fixtures  
- **Integration**: Verify system-wide workflows (e.g., login → data sync → reporting)  
- **Performance**: Use k6 to simulate 10k concurrent users during peak hours  
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions auto-triggers tests on PRs, ensuring no regressions in staging
